label: Fires at D1 after a rare-rewarded a2->S1 trial, stronger later in the episode.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (ep_dec == 9)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1)
explanation: Active only at D1. Its magnitude is almost entirely set by the previous trial being a2 -> S1 (rare) rewarded (residual +0.51; every other pattern about -0.04), and that response gets larger later in the episode (ep_dec slope). Other cues add little: belief decile, the trial before, and future/hidden cues each give <=0.04 alone. The free fit adds only small modulations within a2 S1 r trials (larger if the trial before was also a2, slightly smaller when belief already favours S1), raising dev R^2 from 0.51 to 0.52. The largest remaining misses are D1 steps on the window first trial, where the previous trial lies outside the window, so the pattern cannot be identified. Ceiling for additive cues is 0.48 (all).

issues: The claim that it is 'stronger later in the episode' is wrong at the end of the episode. Fitting a separate weight per episode decile for D1 after a2 S1 r (free fit, test) gives an inverted U: 0.08 for deciles 0-2, then 0.41, 0.65, 0.85, 0.98 and 1.03 for deciles 3-7, then 0.77 at decile 8 and 0.07 at decile 9. In the last 10 trials the feature is close to silent even right after a2 S1 r. This free fit reaches test R^2 0.690 beyond timing, against 0.488 for the recorded short form.

Misses on the recorded short form confirm this: one of the worst dev windows has t96, t97 and t98, all D1 steps after a2 S1 r. The model predicts 0.79 at each; the actual value is 0 each time. The linear ep_dec term over-predicts the whole last decile. The timing baseline shows the same collapse (D1 mean 0.004 at decile 9).

So the recorded short form is under-specified rather than wrong in kind. The large systematic error is the end-of-episode shutoff, not first-trial windows as the explanation says. The free fit's extra terms (belief_lo, trial before) are minor: adding belief_lo to the base term only takes test R^2 from 0.445 to 0.458.

Confirmed: the feature fires only at D1, and the a2 S1 r pattern dominates (residual +0.51 vs about -0.04 elsewhere). Base term alone: test 0.445. Recorded short form: test 0.488 (reproduced). A term for a1 S1 r scaled by belief_lo adds nothing (0.446). belief_cover does not replace the episode-position effect (0.470).

Revised short form: test 0.654 beyond timing. It is clearly better than the recorded 0.488 and above the additive ceiling of 0.48. Under it, no systematic error class remains beyond about -0.03 over-prediction at D1 after other trial types, which is a side effect of the timing baseline.
